annotation.bound_parties_text: No person may use or permit the use of an AV on a road unless it is a pilot use; pilot proprietors, owners of AVs and backup operators are covered, and the Secretary and Commissioner are empowered to make regulations, notices and codes.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No person may—(a) use an AV; or (b) permit the use of an AV, on a road, unless the use is a pilot use.
annotation.dates_quote: This Ordinance comes into operation on a day to be appointed by the Secretary for Transport and Logistics by notice published in the Gazette.
